fields.name: browserId
fields.description: The client browser identifier provided by the client on connection. Multiple connection can share the same browser id to indicate that it should be considered a single session for security reasons.

fields.name: productName
fields.description: The product name provided by the client on connection

fields.description: The product version provided by the client on connection

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The client session identifier provided by the client on connection. Unique for this client/browser session.
